sub_branches.label: Retroperitoneal Fibrosis
sub_branches.why_included: The patient's presentation of asymptomatic left-sided hydronephrosis, along with radiological findings of ill-defined fascial planes around the kidney and thickening around the renal hilum, is consistent with Retroperitoneal Fibrosis.

sub_branches.label: Sarcoidosis
sub_branches.why_included: The patient's presentation of hydronephrosis and inflammatory changes, along with the presence of lymphocytes, eosinophils, and plasma cells, could be consistent with Sarcoidosis.

sub_branches.label: IgG4-related Disease
sub_branches.why_included: The patient's presentation of inflammatory changes and fibrosis, along with the presence of IgG4-positive plasma cells, could be consistent with IgG4-related Disease.
